customdes:
I offer custom website development tailored to your needs. My services include:

- Initial development, with costs and maintenance fees based on the complexity of the project.
- A domain name of your choice.
- An email service for customer inquiries through the contact page.
- Tools to monitor website traffic and performance.
- Development on top of existing projects.

I can also provide several design proposals so you can select the one that best suits your preferences.

bimdes: This was my graduation project for my two-year Software Development program. BIM, or Building Information Modeling, involves creating and managing digital representations of the physical and functional characteristics of buildings and other assets. I developed a tool that made this process more accessible to the product owner's customers.
ticketdes: This was the first project I developed that is still actively used today. The ticketing system tracks errors across all application instances and gives employees a real-time overview of bugs and other issues. This helps them resolve problems consistently and effectively.

Aboutdes: I'm Youri, a full-stack developer who loves turning an idea into something you can actually use. The part I enjoy most is figuring things out: asking questions, experimenting and seeing a solution take shape. These days, I'm especially excited about developing with AI agents. I enjoy exploring how agents can work together, help build software and take repetitive work off people's hands. For me, the fun is in that collaboration: bringing my own ideas and judgment, trying new approaches and refining the result until it feels right. My background in arts and economics still shapes how I build: I care about how something works, how it feels and what it means to the person using it. At WOW media and in my own projects, that curiosity keeps me learning and gives me plenty of reasons to keep building.
